info.title: Mega-Analyzer Unified Dynamic API
info.description: Unified REST API for security researchers to manage bytecode token matchers, Smali ML pattern rules, and web scanner logic on-the-fly.

get.description: Returns runtime telemetry metrics, statistics of active dynamic rules, storage health status, and active connection metrics.

post.description: Triggers crawler and vulnerability fuzz scanner against a target URL, using configured dynamic rules.
Lexes input Smali code in real-time, executing active sequence-matching algorithms.

text.example:
.method public encrypt(Ljava/lang/String;)V
    const-string v0, "DES"
    return-void
.end method

post.description: Allows testing unsaved, raw rules or ML patterns directly against custom payloads, sample text, mock headers, or targets.

rule_json.description: Serialized raw JSON of the rule struct

sample.description: Web URL, bytecode snippet, headers map or simulated ML class context

post.description: Alias of the async scan-job submission endpoint. On this legacy path the scan defaults to synchronous mode (waits for completion and returns the analysis.json report) unless "wait": false is set. Exactly one of target or artifact_id must be provided.

target.description: Local path below MEGA_ANALYZER_SCAN_ROOT (mutually exclusive with artifact_id)

artifact_id.description: ID returned by POST /api/v1/artifacts (mutually exclusive with target)

200.description: Scan completed synchronously — returns the analysis.json report

202.description: Scan job accepted and queued (when wait=false)

post.description: Uploads an APK/AAB/XAPK/JAR/ZIP/DEX file for later scanning via artifact_id. Accepts multipart/form-data (one file part) or a raw request body with an X-Filename header or ?filename= query param.

schema.description: Raw file bytes; provide filename via X-Filename header or ?filename= query param

post.description: Kicks off an analyzer run as a background job and returns immediately with a job ID and status URL (unless "wait": true is set). Exactly one of target or artifact_id must be provided.

target.description: Local path below MEGA_ANALYZER_SCAN_ROOT (mutually exclusive with artifact_id)

artifact_id.description: ID returned by POST /api/v1/artifacts (mutually exclusive with target)

wait.description: Force synchronous (true) or asynchronous (false, default here) behavior

200.description: Scan completed synchronously (when wait=true) — returns the analysis.json report

get.description: Polls the state of an asynchronous scan job (queued, running, succeeded, failed, canceled).

delete.description: Cancels a queued or running scan job.

202.description: Cancellation accepted; job snapshot reflects canceled state

get.description: Streams one of the report artifacts (e.g. analysis.json, REPORT.html) produced by a completed scan job.

200.description: Report content (Content-Type varies by report extension: JSON, HTML, plain text, or CSV)

get.summary: Read or query a completed scan evidence graph

200.description: Evidence graph or bounded evidence chain

get.description: Renders the HTML report (REPORT.html) for a completed scan job, addressed by job_id.
Server-Sent Events stream broadcasting scan lifecycle events (info, crawling, fuzzing, success, vuln_found, error) as they occur. Sends a heartbeat every 15 seconds.

200.description: text/event-stream of ScanEvent JSON payloads, each framed as "data: {...}\n\n"

get.description: Downloads all currently active dynamic web rules, binzap rules, and ML patterns as a single JSON bundle (Content-Disposition: attachment).

post.description: Imports a rules bundle previously produced by GET /api/v1/rules/export. Entries with a blank ID are skipped; entries that fail validation are silently skipped and not counted.
Concurrently probes TCP ports on a public host and optionally grabs service banners. Private/loopback targets are blocked (SSRF protection).

ports.description: Specific ports to scan; defaults to a large common-port list

post.description: Resolves A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME/PTR records for a domain, with optional concurrent subdomain brute-forcing.
Probes TLS 1.0-1.3 support, negotiated cipher suites, and certificate details, then assigns a letter grade.

certificate.description: Subject, issuer, validity window, SAN list, etc.

post.description: Resolves DNS, reverse DNS, probes HTTP/HTTPS banners and headers, and quick-scans common ports for a target host.
Queries the Internet Archive CDX API for the first and latest snapshot of a URL and an approximate total snapshot count.
Fetches the target page and checks security headers, tech-stack fingerprints, robots.txt, security.txt, ads.txt, and sitemap.xml presence.

stack_summary.description: One-line stack summary from the fingerprint engine

technologies.description: Detected tech names with versions, e.g. WordPress 6.4

tech_stack.description: Detailed detections from the WhatWeb-style fingerprint engine

post.description: Queries rdap.org for domain registration data (registrar, key dates, status flags, name servers).

Fetches a page, applies light static JS deobfuscation (hex/unicode escapes, atob, fromCharCode, string-array folding, etc.), scans HTML and linked JS bundles (plus any source maps) for leaked secrets, and detects trackers, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare usage, and forms missing CSRF protection.
Concurrently probes a curated list of sensitive paths (.git/config, .env, backups, CMS configs, actuator endpoints, etc.) and reports which return 200/403.
Replays the request with several attacker-controlled Origin headers to detect wildcard+credentials, origin reflection, and other CORS misconfigurations.

Decodes a JWT's header/payload, flags alg=none and algorithm-confusion risks, checks expiration, scans claims for sensitive data, and brute-forces the HMAC secret against a built-in weak-secret wordlist plus any caller-supplied keys.

weak_keys.description: Additional candidate secrets to try, on top of the built-in weak-secret list

check_alg_none.description: Also return a forged alg=none token for testing

post.description: Appends common redirect-parameter names (url, redirect, next, goto, ...) with attacker-controlled payloads and checks whether the server issues a 3xx redirect to the attacker domain.
Concurrently requests a wordlist of common paths (optionally combined with extensions) against the target and flags sensitive/notable hits.

wordlist.description: Custom path wordlist; defaults to a built-in list

extensions.description: Extensions appended to extensionless words; defaults to ["", ".php", ".html", ".bak", ".old", ".txt"]

post.description: Fingerprints the technology stack from four evidence sources: response headers, cookie names, <meta name=generator> and HTML body patterns. Detects web servers, languages, frameworks, CMS (WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, 1C-Bitrix, DLE), e-commerce, website builders (Tilda, Wix, Webflow), analytics (GA, Yandex Metrika), CDN/WAF, payments and more — with version extraction and confidence levels.

summary.description: One-line stack summary, e.g. WordPress 6.4 · PHP 8.1 · nginx 1.24

final_url.description: Final URL after following redirects (present only when the target redirected)

redirects.description: Redirect chain that led to the final page

post.description: Fetches the target and inspects Set-Cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite), flagging weaknesses more severely for likely session/auth cookies.
Concurrently resolves a wordlist of subdomain labels against the target domain and reports the ones that resolve.

wordlist.description: Custom subdomain wordlist (max 10000 entries); defaults to a built-in list

post.description: Starts the local HTTP(S) intercepting proxy on the given port (default 8888, binds to 127.0.0.1 unless MEGA_ANALYZER_MITM_BIND is set) and returns the ephemeral CA certificate PEM to import for HTTPS interception.

ca_cert_pem.description: PEM-encoded MITM CA certificate to import into the client trust store

post.description: Stops the running MITM proxy listener.

get.description: Returns whether the proxy is running along with request/session counters and CA readiness.
Returns a paged, newest-first list of intercepted request/response sessions.

post.description: Wipes the in-memory session store.
Sets (or clears, then sets) headers that will be injected into every proxied request going forward.

clear.description: If true, replaces the current injected-header set instead of merging into it

get.description: Downloads the ephemeral MITM interception CA certificate as a PEM file, for import into a browser/OS/device trust store.

detail.example: The rules parameters failed syntactic JSON layout validation.

remediation.example: Review payload fields against the OpenAPI schema.
